profile.Name: Short-circuit
profile.Personality: He cannot form words and answers everything with buzzing, which grows louder and more frantic when he is excited or in danger.
profile.Backstory: Drifter in Black Desert City. He lives in Black Desert City. Those who manage to follow his buzzing take it to mean he wants a way out of town.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Only buzzing noises, sometimes ending in a pop and a crack; no words.
